positions.title: System Administrator / Jr. Network Administrator
positions.description:
DC remote hands & troubleshooting of hosted services, Cisco, Nexus, and Foundry switch & router configurations to provision VLANs and IP block assignments. Extensive IP tracking and auditing project to document over 1300 /24s. Development on internal systems in CakePHP framework. Backup provisioning, configuration, and recovery, Zabbix configuration, ASA firewall provisioning. 
Maintain internal documentation into various knowledge base software.

positions.title: Senior System Administrator
positions.description: DC remote hands, troubleshooting of server hardware and all related software, etc. Backup provisioning, configuration, and recovery, High availability load balancing using Barracuda load balancers and HAProxy/Ldirector in Linux, Monitoring system configuration & migration of all systems from Nagios to Zabbix, firewall provisioning, Cisco switch configurations to provision VLANs and IP block assignments. Development of internal systems including PXE autoprovisioning, redundant DNS servers via heartbeat, MySQL database recovery, Openstack VM recovery after fatal SAN backplane failure, New hire training, Maintain internal documentation into various knowledge base software.

positions.description: Remote and onsite support for local small to medium Ft Worth businesses including law firms, magazine publishing, Insurance agencies, etc. Plan and buildout customer infrastructures using Dell servers running MS Small Business Server, incl. positions.title: Junior SysAdmin
positions.description:
Monitor, install, troubleshoot and maintain 300+ systems for email service provider using Stormpost, in house java app managing large scale email lists with integrated features for state of the art tracking and automated opt-out process to ensure CAN-SPAM compliance.
Approx. 50% monitoring, 25% MySQL administration, 15% DNS administration, and 10% Linux administration.

CPanel/WHM, Plesk, & Helm.
